home.practice_tug_blurb: Flick cargo pods across a bay with no gravity. A pod slides until something stops it; bring the right one to rest on the lit clamp.
tug.title: Tug
tug.how_to: Nothing stops by itself in the cargo bay. Swipe a pod and it slides in a straight line until a wall, a block or another pod stops it. One clamp is lit, shaped to the pod it wants: bring that pod to rest on it. Sliding over the clamp does not count, so the art is finding something to stop against, and when nothing is in the right place, putting another pod there first. Every clamp has a par, the fewest flicks that can deliver it. A delivery at par is clean and scores double.
tug.how_to_keyboard: 1 to 4 pick a pod and space picks the next. Arrows or WASD flick the picked pod. X or backspace skips the clamp.
tug.par_note: Clean deliveries in a row build a streak that multiplies them, up to double, and bring harder clamps worth more. A delivery within two flicks of par scores in full, a slower one half, and neither keeps the streak.
tug.skip_note: A clamp gone wrong can be skipped for 15 points and the streak.
tug.hint_note: Practice rounds show the first flick of a par route when you pause.
tug.legend_pods: Cargo pods, each its own shape. A pod slides until a wall, a block or another pod stops it.
tug.legend_clamp: The lit clamp. It is the outline of the pod it wants, and that pod must come to rest in it.
tug.legend_block: A block: a girder stub. Fixed for the round, and a stop like any wall.
tug.legend_ghosts: The picked pod is ringed in amber. A dotted track and a small copy of the pod show where each flick would carry it. The flick that delivers runs a cream track into the clamp.
